notes: Wreath of Lightning: the buff the player wears for fixed_2 seconds; one pulse a second (the text says every second), each a hit of value% weapon damage. Donor Lightning Shield, for its icon and look.
aura_text: Lightning pulses every second, hitting nearby enemies.

notes: Gem of Efficacious Toxin: the poison on an enemy hit, fixed_1 seconds; the value% weapon damage is the total, paid in one tick a second like Rend's bleed (an engineering cadence, not a D3 number). Donor Deadly Poison.
Pain Enhancer: the bleed on an enemy a critical hit landed on, fixed_1 seconds; value% weapon damage as the total, one tick a second. Donor Rend.
Mirinae, Teardrop of the Starweaver: the smite (value% weapon damage as Holy) and the name its heal prints under. Donor Smite.

Moratorium: the combat-log line of the staggered damage paid back over value seconds. How often the module pays what has come due is combat.csv gem_moratorium_pay_period_ms (the designer's; the generator bakes it into this record as the aura period). Donor Shield Wall.
Zei's Stone of Vengeance, rank 25: the stun (rank25_value_2 seconds). Donor Hammer of Justice.
Boyarsky's Chip, rank 25: the taunt (rank25_value_1 seconds). Donor Taunt.
Iceblink: the Chill its Cold skills apply. The slow is gem_iceblink_chill_slow_pct plus the gem's additional slow; how long it lasts is gem_iceblink_chill_seconds (combat.csv). Donor Chilled.

Bane of the Trapped, rank 25: the slow its aura puts on every enemy within rank25_value_1 yards (rank25_value_2 %). The module refreshes it every gem_aura_refresh_ms (combat.csv) and it lasts twice that, so an enemy that leaves the aura sheds it. Donor Hamstring.

Molten Wildebeest's Gizzard, rank 25: the absorb shield (rank25_value_2 % of the player's Life per Second) the player wears after rank25_value_1 seconds without taking damage. The sheet gives it no duration: it lasts until it is absorbed or replaced. Donor Power Word: Shield.
Simplicity's Strength, rank 25: the name the heal of a Primary skill's hit (rank25_value_1 % of maximum Life) prints under. Donor Holy Light.
